name: @taubyte/tcc-v2-explorer
description: Live view of the tau v2 DSL: edit the config, compile it in the browser with tcc, see the graph it produces.

scripts.gen: cd ../../../../.. && go run ./tools/tcc-gen --dsl v2 --wasm --out pkg/tcc/taubyte/v2/explorer/public && go run ./tools/tcc-gen --dsl v2 --ts --out pkg/tcc/taubyte/v2/explorer/src/gen
